senses.gloss: † धिष् धिष्, ii. 3, Par. To emit sound.

धिषण धिषण,
 I. n. An abode, a seat, Bhāg. P. 3, 16, 33.
 II. f. णा,
 1. Intellect, Bhāg. P. 1, 15, 47.
 2. The name of one of the wives of the gods, MBh. 9, 2516.
 3. A proper name, Bhāg. P. 6, 6, 20.
धिष्ठ्य धिष्ठ्य, n. A seat, an abode, Bhāg. P. 4, 2, 6 (probably to be changed to धिष्ण्य).
धिष्ठ्यप धिष्ठ्य-प, m. A cherisher of the world, Bhāg. P. 7, 8, 27.

धिष्ण्य धिष्ण्य (i. e. probably धा + स्न + य),
 I. m. A fireplace, Bhāg. P. 8, 15, 9.
 II. n.
 1. An abode, a seat, Bhāg. P. 8, 3, 27; MBh. 3, 17090. A meteor, MBh. 5, 7272.
धी- + सचिव धी- + सचिव, m. a counsellor, Rājat. 2, 67.
